fields.title: About Flash News Kenya
fields.content:
Kenya's Trusted Source for Breaking News, Investigative Journalism, In-Depth Analysis, and Verified Facts.

Welcome to Flash News Kenya, a modern digital news platform committed to delivering accurate, timely, balanced, and independent journalism to readers across Kenya and around the world.

In today's fast-moving digital age, information spreads in seconds—but not all information is true. At Flash News Kenya, we believe that speed should never come at the expense of accuracy. Every story we publish is carefully researched, verified, and presented with the highest standards of journalistic integrity.

Facts First. Truth Always.

Who We Are

Flash News Kenya is an independent online news organization dedicated to informing, educating, and empowering the public through credible journalism. Our newsroom is driven by experienced writers, editors, researchers, and contributors who are passionate about uncovering the truth and telling the stories that shape our nation.

From breaking headlines and investigative reports to business insights, technology, sports, politics, county news, and international affairs, we bring our readers comprehensive coverage they can rely on every day.

Our Mission

To deliver factual, timely, and unbiased journalism that informs the public, promotes accountability, encourages meaningful conversations, and strengthens democracy through access to credible information.

Our Vision

To become Kenya's most trusted and respected digital news platform, recognized for fearless reporting, editorial excellence, innovation, and an unwavering commitment to truth.

What We Cover

Flash News Kenya provides comprehensive news coverage from across the country and around the world, ensuring our readers stay informed wherever they are.

  • 📰 Breaking News
  • 🏛 Politics & Governance
  • 🏘 County News
  • 💼 Business & Economy
  • 📈 Markets & Finance
  • 💻 Technology & Innovation
  • 🏥 Health
  • 🎓 Education
  • 🌍 International News
  • 🌱 Environment & Climate
  • 🚜 Agriculture
  • ⚽ Sports
  • 🎭 Entertainment
  • ⚖ Crime & Justice
  • 🔍 Investigations
  • 💡 Opinion & Analysis

Our Editorial Principles

Trust is earned through consistency, transparency, and accountability. Every article published by Flash News Kenya follows strict editorial standards designed to protect the integrity of our journalism.

  • ✔ Accuracy before speed.
  • ✔ Independent and impartial reporting.
  • ✔ Thorough fact-checking and source verification.
  • ✔ Fair representation of all sides of a story.
  • ✔ Clear distinction between news, opinion, and sponsored content.
  • ✔ Prompt corrections whenever errors are identified.
  • ✔ Respect for ethical journalism and responsible reporting.

Why Readers Trust Flash News Kenya

Thousands of readers choose Flash News Kenya because we are committed to delivering news that is credible, relevant, and impactful.

⚡ Breaking News

Fast updates on major events as they happen.

✅ Verified Information

Every story is carefully fact-checked before publication.

🔍 Investigative Journalism

In-depth reporting that uncovers stories others miss.

📊 Expert Analysis

Helping readers understand the events behind the headlines.

🌍 Nationwide Coverage

News from all 47 counties and beyond.

📱 Modern Digital Experience

Fast, responsive, and accessible on every device.

Powered by Innovation

Flash News Kenya combines professional journalism with modern technology to deliver a seamless reading experience. Our platform is designed for speed, security, accessibility, and reliability, allowing readers to access trusted news anytime, anywhere.

Serving Every Kenyan

Whether you're in Nairobi, Mombasa, Kisumu, Nakuru, Eldoret, Garissa, Nyeri, Kakamega, Lodwar, Mandera, Wajir, Marsabit, or anywhere else in Kenya—or you're part of the Kenyan diaspora—Flash News Kenya keeps you connected to the stories shaping our nation and the world.

Our Core Values

Truth
Integrity
Accuracy
Independence
Fairness
Transparency
Accountability
Innovation
Public Service
Excellence

Our Promise

At Flash News Kenya, journalism is more than reporting events—it's about informing communities, holding institutions accountable, amplifying voices, and helping citizens make informed decisions.

We are committed to earning your trust every single day through factual, independent, and responsible journalism.

Stay Informed. Stay Empowered. Stay Ahead.

Flash News Kenya — Facts First. Truth Always.

fields.title: Contact Us
fields.content:

At Flash News Kenya, we value open communication with our readers, partners, and the wider community. Journalism thrives through collaboration, and your voice helps us report the stories that matter.

If you have breaking news, eyewitness information, press releases, advertising opportunities, or would simply like to get in touch, don't hesitate to contact us. Every inquiry is handled professionally and with the utmost confidentiality.

How Can We Help?

✍ Editorial

📢 Advertising

🤝 Partnerships

Collaborate with us on events, campaigns, and media partnerships.

💬 Feedback

We welcome your ideas and suggestions on how we can serve you better.

📨 General Enquiries

Need assistance? Our support team is happy to help.

Find Us

Our offices are conveniently located along Sankuri Road in Garissa Township, Garissa County, next to Pegler Paints North Eastern Depot.

Office Location

📍 Flash News Kenya
Next to Pegler Paints North Eastern Depot
Sankuri Road
Garissa Township
Garissa County
Kenya

Our Commitment

Every message we receive is treated with professionalism and respect. We are committed to protecting confidential sources and handling sensitive information responsibly in accordance with the highest standards of journalism.

Your trust is our greatest asset, and we strive to maintain it through transparency, accountability, and responsive communication.

Let's Stay Connected

Whether you're a reader, journalist, organization, advertiser, or community member, we're always happy to hear from you.

Email us today:
info@flash.co.ke

Together, let's keep Kenya informed.

fields.title: Terms and Conditions
fields.content:
Last updated: 24 July 2026

These Terms and Conditions ("Terms") govern your access to and use of the Flash News website, mobile applications, newsletters and related services (together, the "Service"), operated by Flash News ("Flash News", "we", "us" or "our"), a news media organisation based in Garissa County, Kenya. By accessing or using the Service you agree to be bound by these Terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the Service.

These Terms should be read together with our Privacy Policy, which explains how we handle your personal data in accordance with the Data Protection Act, No. 24 of 2019 (Kenya).

1. Who we are

Flash News is a digital news publisher committed to accurate, fair and independent journalism, operating under the framework of the Constitution of Kenya, 2010 — in particular the freedoms of expression (Article 33), the media (Article 34) and access to information (Article 35) — and the Media Council Act, 2013. You can reach us at info@flashnews.co.ke or at our offices next to Pegler Paints North Eastern Depot, Sankuri Road, Garissa Township, Garissa County, Kenya.

2. Definitions

  • "Content" means all text, images, audio, video, graphics and other material published on the Service.
  • "User Content" means comments, feedback, submissions or other material you post or send to us.
  • "You" or "User" means any person who accesses or uses the Service.

3. Eligibility

You must be at least 18 years old, or the age of majority in your jurisdiction, to create an account, subscribe or post User Content. If you are under 18, you may only use the Service under the supervision of a parent or legal guardian. We handle children's data in line with the Data Protection Act, 2019 and the Children Act, 2022.

4. Licence to use the Service

We grant you a limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable and revocable licence to access and use the Service for your personal, non-commercial use. You may view, share links to, and make limited personal copies of Content for private reference. You may not, without our prior written permission, reproduce, republish, scrape, sell, systematically download, or create derivative works from our Content.

5. Intellectual property and copyright

All Content on the Service is protected by the Copyright Act, No. 12 of 2001 (as amended) and other applicable intellectual property laws. Except for third-party material used under licence, credit or fair dealing, all Content is owned by or licensed to Flash News.

Where we aggregate or reference reporting from other newsrooms, we publish a headline, a short summary and a source credit, and we link to or acknowledge the original publisher — we do not republish another outlet's full article as our own. If you believe any Content infringes your copyright, contact us at info@flashnews.co.ke with details and we will investigate and, where appropriate, remove or correct the material.

6. User Content and comments

You are solely responsible for any User Content you submit. By submitting User Content, you grant Flash News a worldwide, royalty-free, non-exclusive licence to use, reproduce, edit, publish and display it in connection with the Service.

You agree not to post User Content that:

  • is defamatory, false or misleading (see the Defamation Act, Cap 36);
  • constitutes hate speech, incitement to violence, or ethnic contempt, contrary to the National Cohesion and Integration Act, 2008;
  • is obscene, harassing, threatening, or invades another person's privacy;
  • infringes any intellectual property or other right;
  • amounts to an offence under the Computer Misuse and Cybercrimes Act, 2018 (for example, false publication, cyber harassment or unauthorised access); or
  • is unlawful under any other law of Kenya.

We may moderate, edit, refuse or remove User Content at our discretion, and we may suspend or terminate accounts that breach these Terms. We do not endorse and are not responsible for opinions expressed in User Content.

7. Editorial standards and Code of Ethics

Flash News subscribes to the Code of Conduct for the Practice of Journalism in Kenya set out in the Second Schedule to the Media Council Act, 2013, and to the following ethical processes and procedures:

7.1 Accuracy and fairness

We take reasonable steps to verify information before publication, to represent facts accurately, and to give a fair opportunity to reply to any person or organisation criticised in our reporting. Where we cannot independently verify a claim, we attribute it clearly.

7.2 Independence and integrity

Our editorial decisions are independent of advertisers, owners, political and commercial interests. Journalists must declare and avoid conflicts of interest, must not accept gifts or favours that could compromise their impartiality, and must not use information obtained in their work for personal gain.

7.3 Sources and confidentiality

We protect the identity of confidential sources who provide information in the public interest, and we seek to corroborate information from more than one source where practicable. We do not fabricate sources or quotations.

7.4 Distinguishing fact from comment

We clearly distinguish reporting of fact from analysis, opinion and comment, and we identify sponsored or advertising content as such.

7.5 Privacy and the public interest

We respect the right to privacy under Article 31 of the Constitution. Intrusion into private life is only justified where there is a genuine and demonstrable public interest that outweighs the individual's right to privacy.

7.6 Protection of the vulnerable

We take special care when reporting on children, and do not identify children in ways that are contrary to the Children Act, 2022. We handle survivors of sexual offences in line with the Sexual Offences Act, 2006, and we report on grief, trauma, suicide and tragedy with sensitivity and restraint.

7.7 Avoiding harm

We avoid gratuitous publication of graphic, obscene or shocking material, and we weigh the public interest against the potential for harm before publishing. We do not plagiarise.

7.8 Elections and public affairs

In covering elections and matters of public interest we strive for balance, accuracy and impartiality, consistent with guidance issued by the Media Council of Kenya and the Independent Electoral and Boundaries Commission.

8. Corrections, clarifications and complaints

Accuracy matters to us. If you believe we have published something inaccurate, unfair or in breach of our ethical standards, we want to put it right:

  1. Contact the editor. Email info@flashnews.co.ke with the headline, URL, the date of publication and a description of the concern. We aim to acknowledge complaints promptly and to publish a correction or clarification where a factual error is established.
  2. Escalate to the Media Council of Kenya. If you are not satisfied with our response, you may lodge a complaint with the Complaints Commission of the Media Council of Kenya, the statutory body that adjudicates complaints against journalists and media houses under the Media Council Act, 2013.

9. Advertising and sponsored content

The Service carries advertising and may carry sponsored or affiliate content, which we label. Advertisements do not influence our editorial coverage. We are not responsible for the products, services or claims of advertisers, and any dealings you have with advertisers are solely between you and the advertiser.

10. Newsletters and subscriptions

If you subscribe to our newsletters, you consent to receive periodic emails. You may unsubscribe at any time using the link in each email or by contacting us. We process subscription data in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

11. Third-party links

The Service may link to third-party websites and services that we do not control. We are not responsible for their content, terms or privacy practices, and inclusion of a link is not an endorsement.

12. Disclaimers

The Service and its Content are provided for general information and news purposes only, on an "as is" and "as available" basis. While we strive for accuracy, we do not warrant that the Content is complete, current or error-free. Nothing on the Service constitutes legal, financial, medical or other professional advice; you should seek independent professional advice before acting on any information published here.

13. Limitation of liability

To the fullest extent permitted by law, Flash News shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special or consequential loss, or any loss of profits, data, goodwill or reputation, arising from your use of, or inability to use, the Service. Nothing in these Terms excludes or limits liability that cannot lawfully be excluded or limited under Kenyan law, including under the Consumer Protection Act, No. 46 of 2012.

14. Indemnity

You agree to indemnify and hold harmless Flash News, its directors, employees and contributors from any claims, losses or expenses arising out of your User Content, your use of the Service, or your breach of these Terms or of any law.

15. Governing law and jurisdiction

These Terms are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of Kenya. Any dispute arising out of or in connection with the Service or these Terms shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Kenya. Before resorting to litigation, the parties shall attempt in good faith to resolve the dispute amicably, and may use mediation.

16. Changes to these Terms

We may update these Terms from time to time. The "Last updated" date above reflects the latest revision, and material changes take effect when posted. Continued use of the Service after changes are posted constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.

17. General

If any provision of these Terms is held to be invalid or unenforceable, the remaining provisions continue in full force. These Terms, together with the Privacy Policy, constitute the entire agreement between you and Flash News regarding the Service.

18. Contact us

Questions about these Terms may be sent to info@flashnews.co.ke, or by post to Flash News, Sankuri Road, Garissa Township, Garissa County, Kenya.

fields.title: Privacy Policy
fields.content:
Last updated: 24 July 2026

Flash News ("we", "us" or "our") respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal data. This Privacy Policy explains what personal data we collect when you use our website, mobile applications, newsletters and related services (the "Service"), how we use and protect it, and the rights you have. It is written to comply with Article 31 of the Constitution of Kenya, 2010 (the right to privacy) and the Data Protection Act, No. 24 of 2019 and its regulations (together, the "DPA").

1. Who we are (data controller)

Flash News is the data controller responsible for your personal data. We are a news media organisation based next to Pegler Paints North Eastern Depot, Sankuri Road, Garissa Township, Garissa County, Kenya. For any privacy matter, contact our data protection contact at info@flashnews.co.ke. Where required, we are registered with the Office of the Data Protection Commissioner (ODPC) as a data controller.

2. The data protection principles we follow

In line with Section 25 of the DPA, we process personal data lawfully, fairly and transparently; only for specified and legitimate purposes; limited to what is necessary; accurate and kept up to date; retained no longer than necessary; and protected with appropriate security.

3. Personal data we collect

3.1 Information you give us

  • Newsletter subscription: your email address (and any category preferences) when you subscribe.
  • Comments and submissions: your name or display name, email and the content you post.
  • Contact messages: your name, email and message when you contact us or send a correction request.
  • Account data: if you register, your username, email and profile details.

3.2 Information we collect automatically

  • First-party analytics: we run our own privacy-friendly analytics. When you read a page we record the page path, the time spent on the page, a coarse traffic-source category derived from your referrer (for example "search" or "social"), and a random, cookie-free session identifier stored in your browser. This identifier is not linked to your name and is used only to estimate how many distinct visitors we have.
  • Technical and log data: our servers may log your IP address, browser type, device and access times for security and diagnostics.
  • Advertising: we record aggregate ad impressions and clicks to measure ad performance.

3.3 Cookies and local storage

We use browser local storage and, where applicable, cookies to make the Service work and to remember your preferences, including:

  • an anonymous analytics session identifier (flash_sid);
  • authentication tokens for signed-in staff and registered users; and
  • where you enable them, third-party analytics or advertising cookies.

You can control or delete cookies and local storage through your browser settings. Disabling them may affect some features of the Service.

4. How we use your data and our lawful basis

We process personal data on the lawful bases set out in Section 30 of the DPA:

  • Consent — to send you newsletters and to set non-essential cookies. You may withdraw consent at any time.
  • Performance of a contract — to provide accounts, services and features you request.
  • Legitimate interests — to operate, secure and improve the Service, understand our audience through aggregate analytics, and prevent abuse, provided these interests are not overridden by your rights.
  • Legal obligation — to comply with the law and respond to lawful requests from public authorities.

We do not sell your personal data.

5. Sharing and disclosure

We may share personal data with:

  • Service providers (for example hosting, email delivery and, if enabled, Google Analytics or advertising partners) who process data on our behalf under written agreements consistent with the DPA;
  • Public authorities where required by law, court order, or to protect our rights, users or the public; and
  • A successor entity in the event of a merger, acquisition or reorganisation, subject to this Policy.

6. Cross-border transfers

Some of our service providers may process data outside Kenya. Where personal data is transferred across borders, we do so in accordance with Sections 48 and 49 of the DPA — ensuring appropriate safeguards and an adequate level of protection, or relying on your consent or another lawful ground.

7. Data retention

We keep personal data only for as long as necessary for the purposes described in this Policy or as required by law. Newsletter data is kept until you unsubscribe; analytics events are kept in aggregate form; comments remain while published unless you request removal.

8. Data security

We apply appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect personal data against unauthorised access, alteration, disclosure or destruction. In the event of a personal data breach that poses a real risk to your rights, we will notify the ODPC and affected data subjects as required by Section 43 of the DPA.

9. Your rights as a data subject

Under Section 26 of the DPA you have the right:

  • to be informed of the use of your personal data;
  • to access the personal data we hold about you;
  • to rectification of inaccurate or incomplete data;
  • to erasure ("deletion") of your data where there is no lawful reason to keep it;
  • to object to, or request restriction of, processing;
  • to data portability, where applicable; and
  • not to be subject to a decision based solely on automated processing.

To exercise any of these rights, email info@flashnews.co.ke. We will respond within the timeframes set by the DPA. We may need to verify your identity before acting on a request.

10. Children's privacy

The Service is not directed at children under 18, and we do not knowingly collect their personal data without the consent of a parent or guardian, in line with the DPA and the Children Act, 2022. If you believe a child has provided us data, please contact us so we can remove it.

11. Complaints

If you have a concern about how we handle your personal data, please contact us first at info@flashnews.co.ke so we can try to resolve it. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the regulator:

Office of the Data Protection Commissioner (ODPC)
Website: www.odpc.go.ke
Email: info@odpc.go.ke

12. Third-party links

Our Service may link to third-party sites with their own privacy practices. We are not responsible for those sites, and we encourage you to read their privacy policies.

13. Changes to this Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The "Last updated" date above shows the latest revision. Where changes are material, we will take reasonable steps to bring them to your attention.

14. Contact us

For any question about this Policy or your personal data, contact us at info@flashnews.co.ke, or by post to Flash News, Sankuri Road, Garissa Township, Garissa County, Kenya.
